climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: An enduring geographical indication covering the South Island's wine areas, including Marlborough, Nelson, Canterbury and Central Otago. It is dominated by Sauvignon Blanc at about 74% of the vines, with Pinot Noir at 14%.
